title: Plan Yapmak & Katılmak
goalTr: İnsanlara katıl, plan yap, Instagram/WhatsApp al, buluşma ayarla. Bali'de sosyalleşmenin pratiği.

chunks.en: Are you guys doing anything later?
Do you have any plans for tomorrow?

chunks.ex: We're going to the beach. — Mind if I join?

chunks.en: Do you want to grab a drink later?
chunks.tr: Sonra bir şeyler içmek ister misin?
chunks.use: 'grab' = hızlıca almak/yapmak: grab a drink, grab food, grab a coffee.

chunks.ex: We're going surfing at 7. — I'm down!

quick.sample: Probably just dinner somewhere. Why, what's up?

quick.q: Do you have any plans for tomorrow?
quick.sample: Not yet — I'm thinking of going to Uluwatu.
How about seven? At the beach bar?

quick.q: Are you coming to the waterfall with us?
quick.sample: I'd love to! What time are you guys going?
It's hakan-something — here, let me type it.
Yeah — put your number in, I'll text you.
Let's meet at the beach entrance, by the big tree.

quick.q: Can you send me the location?
quick.sample: Sure, I'll send it on WhatsApp right now.
Yeah! Running a little late, but I'm coming.

social.stmt: We're heading to a waterfall tomorrow, wanna come?
samples: Yeah, I'm down! What time are you going?
I might join — I'll let you know tonight.
I'd love to, but I already have plans. Next time?

social.stmt: There's a party at the beach club tonight.
samples: I'm not really into clubs, to be honest. But have fun!
Ah, I might be a little late. Save me a spot!

social.stmt: We found an amazing warung yesterday.
samples: Nice! Where is it? I'm down to try it.
Oh yeah? What did you have?
Oh cool, where are you heading?
Mind if I join? I've been wanting to explore.

social.stmt: We're doing a sunrise hike on Thursday.
samples: That sounds amazing! I've never done one. Can I join you guys?

social.stmt: We're going to Uluwatu for sunset.
samples: Nice! I've heard good things about it. What time are you heading there?

social.stmt: We might check out the night market later.
samples: Oh, I'm up for that! I haven't been yet. Where should we meet?

grammar.title: Planlar: going to / thinking of / might

intro.ex: I'm going to take a surf lesson. (kesin plan)
I'm thinking of going to Uluwatu. (fikir aşaması)
Wanna grab a drink? / Are you up for a hike?

drills.best: I'm thinking of going to Uluwatu tomorrow.
I might go out tonight — I'm not sure yet.
I'm going to take a surf lesson tomorrow morning.
Do you wanna grab a drink?

scenario.title: Havuz Başı + WhatsApp
scenario.situationTr: Havuz başında bir grupla tanıştın; akşam planına dahil oluyorsun. Sohbetin ikinci yarısı WhatsApp mesajlaşması!
scenario.goalTr: Gruba katıl (Mind if I join?), Instagram/WhatsApp al, buluşmayı mesajla netleştir (konum, saat, gecikme).

personas.name: Nils
personas.plan: a warung dinner then some live music

beats.ai: ...and that's why {name} here can't surf anymore, haha! Oh hey, you're at the hostel too, right?
beats.tr: ...işte bu yüzden {name} artık sörf yapamıyor, haha! Hey, sen de hostelde kalıyorsun, değil mi?
beats.sample: Haha, yeah I am! I'm Hakan. What happened?

beats.ai: Long story, haha. We're all heading to {plan} later. You should come!
beats.tr: Uzun hikâye, haha. Biz sonra {plan}'a gidiyoruz. Sen de gelsene!
beats.sample: I'm down! What time are you guys going?

beats.ai: {time}-ish, probably. You on WhatsApp? We have a group.
beats.tr: Muhtemelen {time} gibi. WhatsApp'ın var mı? Grubumuz var.
beats.sample: Yeah! Put your number in — or what's your Instagram?

beats.ai: Sweet, I'll add you to the group. Okay, see you later!
beats.tr: Süper, seni gruba ekliyorum. Tamam, sonra görüşürüz!

beats.ai: (WhatsApp, 16:40) Hey! We're still going to {plan} later, right?
beats.tr: (WhatsApp) Selam! Sonra {plan}'a hâlâ gidiyoruz, değil mi?
beats.sample: Yeah! What time are you guys heading there?
Meet at the hostel entrance? Or send me the location.

beats.ai: (WhatsApp) I'll send the location. We're leaving in 15!
beats.sample: Okay! I might be a little late — save me a spot!

beats.ai: (WhatsApp) Haha no worries. See you there!
(At the bar) Heyyy, you made it! What do you want to drink?
beats.sample: Of course! Whatever you guys are having.
